unselected_requirements_policy: All remaining IDs stay in the canonical register; selection does not cancel their scope.

acceptance_cases.test: All 132 IDs, source summaries and existing row fields survive unchanged except recorded recovery status; unselected work remains tracked.
Explicit city selection distinguishes Göteborg, another city and unknown context without inventing a local forum or physical venue.
Browse and participate in ordinary conversation without creating a request, project, economic transaction or productivity report.
Private draft remains private; submitting a Host request explicitly shares only the intended fields with the assigned authorised Host.
Unrelated Host, ordinary project member, blocked user and unauthenticated caller cannot discover/read a private request; reassignment revokes inappropriate old access.
Absent/unavailable Host or declined assistance is honestly shown; independent City browsing and ordinary community use remain available.
Host clarifies purpose and constraints, offers voluntary useful options; the requester may refuse 1+1 or any recommendation without penalty.
Capability shows provider, source, distinct dates, price/eligibility/accessibility including unknowns; public listing is not labelled signed partnership.
Stale, removed, unavailable or materially changed resource triggers uncertainty/re-review; prior source/version is not silently replaced.
Before handoff, requester selects recipient and fields; no whole request/history transfer, automatic forum import or identity linking occurs.
Referral issuance, external contact, provider acceptance, booking and official submission remain distinct; failed manual/external handoff is not marked complete.
Requester deliberately creates or links one authorised existing cooperation/project using a reviewed excerpt and public source reference.
Double submission, timeout/retry and concurrent edits do not create duplicate projects/referrals or silently overwrite another accepted version.
Project/work-chat members can read authorised project information but cannot infer private request identity, constraints or existence through backlinks/errors.
Participants can follow source-backed resource → next action → task/assignee/work chat; a venue is available only on the provider's actual terms.
Issued, used and useful are independent; done/closed does not fill outcome fields; no response and prefer-not-to-say stay explicit.
Reporter claims, other-party confirmation, external evidence and integrity remain separate; disagreement never becomes an unqualified verified-success badge.
Withdrawal, follow-up refusal, correction, dispute and approved erasure/retention rules work without rewriting evidence or promising to retract already delivered data.
Consequential choice records objective, relevant alternatives, chosen route, authority and time; Host suggestion/model output is not treated as user authorisation.
Connected Mura story uses authored data and existing story IDs, distinguishes working UI from future service, and creates no real request or external write.
No registration inside Mura; explicit exit clears illustrative state before the own account; no copying of Mura/private drafts into shared records.
Eleven languages, RTL, keyboard and screen-reader paths, five-item primary navigation, small/landscape layouts and back/reload visibly work rather than merely changing a highlight.
Mura/synthetic data excluded; report denominators and response completeness; partial, unknown and declined results never silently count as full success.
Real authorised accounts, named available Host/operator, consented provider handoff where needed, privacy controls and separate physical-device review precede any end-to-end delivery claim.
